literal: Without caring, he who loved is there, alas! But him without seeing, peace have not the eyes.
translation: He who once loved me but cares for me no longer is still there, alas! But my eyes find no peace without seeing him.
modern: என்னை முன்பு விரும்பி இப்போது பேணாமல் இருப்பவர் அங்கே இருக்கிறார். ஆனால் அவரைப் பார்க்காமல் என் கண்கள் அமைதி அடைவதில்லை.
explanation: The heroine laments the state of her eyes, which long to see her lover. She notes the irony that the man who once desired her now shows no care for her suffering, yet her eyes refuse to rest until they see him. The word 'பேணாது' (without caring) contrasts with 'பெட்டார்' (he who loved), highlighting his changed attitude, while 'அமைவு இல' (have no peace) shows her eyes' uncontrollable longing.
